item_short_desc: Rothco’s 1st Response E.M.S. Holster Set features shears, scissors, forceps, and a penlight, all within an arm’s reach so you can thrive on-the-job.
description: Rothco's 1st Response E.M.S. Holster Set is the complete tool set for emergency responder. The emergency kit includes 7.25" shears, 5.50" scissors, penlight and 4.50" forceps.
